title: Major Housing Budgets Greenlit
meeting_type: Austin Housing Finance Corporation (AHFC) Board of Directors AHFC Meeting
summary:
*   The Austin Housing Finance Corporation approved its Fiscal Year 2010-2011 Grant Operating Budget, totaling over $8.1 million.
*   This funding supports various housing assistance programs and grants for the community, with guidelines to be developed.
*   An additional $6.4 million Capital Budget was approved for housing-related projects for the upcoming fiscal year, bringing the total housing investment to over $14.6 million.
